Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The title «Неужели так надо?» (Neuzheli tak nado?, literally 'Is it really necessary so?') is 'Must It Be So?'; the incredulous «неужели» (neuzheli, 'can it really be that') is carried by 'really' in the closing line «Неужели это так надо?» ('Must this really be so?'). Russian measures are kept: 100 «аршин» (arshin, about 71 cm each) and horses of 'five vershoks' («пятивершковых», pyativershkovykh: 2 arshins and 5 «вершков», vershkov, at the withers, a tall horse), 2,000 «десятин» (desyatin, about 1.1 hectares each). The website draft's paraphrases were revised throughout, e.g. «каторжного труда» (katorzhnogo truda, 'convict labor') is 'hard labor', and «чужое поле» / «чужую работу» (chuzhoye pole, chuzhuyu rabotu) are 'someone else's field' and 'work for others'.
